notes.title: v1.4: New map and optimization
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New map: Ancient Chinese style buildings and mountains.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/0fb6d960d25442c8f284c5754ad5ef0a0304935f.png[/img]
[*] Add the function to control the weather, press N to change the day and night and also change the weather randomly.
[*] Weather system improvements and optimizations
[*] Model texture material optimization, reducing game size and improving game loading speed
[*] Landscape optimization, scene detail improvement, plant LOD optimization, improved frame rate
[*] The music has been improved, softer and calmer, poetic
[/list]

notes.title: v1.3 new winter map: Aurora Forest
notes.content:
[h1]New content:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/d556681b8b1fb14325c8cbc04e98122259abdc92.jpg[/img]
New map: Aurora Forest. This is a map of the winter environment. You can drive 3 kinds of cars on snowy road and enjoy the beautiful snow scenery. You can see the colorful aurora at night. 
Hurry up and set off fireworks to celebrate the New Year!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/f75909d33e4f249d119a6d24be89a76aceab85f9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/42911ae8e27609aca47760345eca27d70298de6f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/f0e1cc52a0f1599755f9b58b2dd9cb74462aa9e9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/235582509f98c288e62a669a3152be3e4ec49809.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/2dbed9f4534a4272d45a62d060313d894160ce6b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/a84a0816d2761edeaab4dbd17b213e9400a5d255.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/3375f4f636d8f999155fb709a225955a1a53bad9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/624adffa13a53232eeeb0df4e78f92d97dddb6ef.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/3ccb84639a29e5f58d7387c33a76220a8655ec88.jpg[/img]
[h1]Improvements and fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved car driving, smoother operation
[*]Added map loading interface
[*] Improved the reflection of the water surface, more beautiful reflection effect, reflecting the brilliant and bright fireworks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/d8325fbb684f68f6b6caac7641b95ea0a03e58a6.jpg[/img]
[*] More map details have been added, and the scenery is more beautiful.
[*] Fix the bug that the UI display error when returning to the main menu after the game is over
[*] Improved weather system, you can see more types of weather, such as thunderstorms, blizzards
[*] Optimized maps and plant LOD to increase frame rate, texture compression optimization, redundant content cleaning, and reduced game packaging size.
[*] Improved night brightness
[*] Fixed the effect of shadow flickering and light exposure on fireworks
[/list]

notes.title: v1.2: New fireworks, grassland map, drivable cars
notes.content:
[h2]New content:[/h2]
[h3]Add 3 drivable cars [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/5e167d0fcce211fbaf14f35a2e6886aafd092e40.jpg[/img]
You can experience the joy of driving in the open map, so this is not only a firework simulation game, but also a driving simulation game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/7956e26ce95d466802225add9d16bc9852114f14.png[/img]
[h3]New map: [/h3]
The vast and beautiful grassland, you can indulge in driving and admire the magnificent sunrise and sunset.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/49a596ee782241249bc1af67d583fa0e3d5cb5ad.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/6da3df7ad1017ecbab8f243fa0ecbebec6331da0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/6cc3c4ead4379843257ec46d4654f42ca00b8deb.png[/img]
[h3]New female player character[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/f2a092c092fae5840751e6b58da567a38854c6ca.png[/img]
Added several NPC audience roles to the park map
[h3]New types of fireworks[/h3]
New and more beautiful firework particle effects, optimized particle lighting, and reduced graphics card consumption
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/a9eab517305e866b553cad7a7fa153a082817d48.png[/img]
Improve the time control function, press N once to go to night, and press N again to day, to realize day and night cycle，Random dynamic cloud
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/556290abcb7751e776f21f75c65a43582537f16e.png[/img]
Map environmental details beautify
Add the environmental sound effects of birdsong and wind, which will only be heard during the day
Add an elevator on the bridge, Take the elevator to the sky to overlook the fireworks, jump down and press Z for slow time to enjoy the bright fireworks rain.
[h2]Bug fix:[/h2]
Fixed the bug of  start the  VR devices, this game does not support VR
Fixed the main menu interface, press ESC to jump out of the blank interface

notes.title: v1.1New menu and Dynamic Sky
notes.content:
[h3]New content:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/c0acfc2fb018b0078b903291fabc45969ed4079f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The new game menu can set the graphics quality and sound, mouse sensitivity, etc., support 2K, 4K, 8K resolution settings
[*] The new day and night cycle, you can switch to night mode in real time by pressing N in the game, and enjoy the fireworks feast in the starry night. The new sky has randomly generated dynamic cloud layers, and you will see beautiful sunrise and sunset daytime landscapes. In the future, real dynamic weather systems will be added, including rainfall, lightning, and snowfall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/f2a6aac11c97c1e75f065f6a97789bd52f737a0a.png[/img]
[*] Add 10 wonderful music that plays randomly, you can set the volume of music and sound effects in the menu or turn off directly
[*] New landscape elements, beautiful flowers and plants, let you feel the beautiful spring
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/d2b21e460652fdb25ae45dfb36b2fce814324406.png[/img]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/f8448a9ea221cf53fc71568d2ac405e350562bad.png[/img]
[h3]Bug fixes and improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug that the English localization of the game guide showed the language of other countries. I am here to say sorry to friends who use English, because of a small error in the localization of the engine, the release of this patch has been delayed for many days, Now the English localized content display works well.
[*] Improved footsteps
[/list]
[b]Upcoming content: female character and third-person view, new maps, etc...
[/b]
We will continue to update new content in the future, thank you for your support, I wish you a happy game time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39864179/80e3febd1833a61429922f31c1dd155bd9248dcf.jpg[/img]
